context:
Goal: accurate work landed at the fastest speed.
Problem (goal): 356 built PRs sit unbatched, some repeat each other, and because sessions lose track the sort has to live in a file and a script rather than in anyone's memory.
Based on (measured): the lost-lanes audit at 09:55 CST found 356 of 410 open lane PRs unbatched; at 10:41 CST, 53 steps hold 2 or more of them (199 PRs), such as bg-tail-loses-verdict with 7 PRs on a step already done and notes-fix-large-3 with 17.
Based on (ruling): your 09:26 CST call on step handin-cannot-drop: PRs with a done record join batches mechanically.
Based on (notes): your 10:41 CST words: work under 48 h is fresh but may be repeats; older work is probably still valid but needs a quick glance over.
Departs from: main, which has no ledger of lost PRs and no check against a second lane on a step with an open PR — adds one ledger file, a duplicate check, and a lane that drains the ledger to zero.

options.gain: Every PR ends merged, closed as a duplicate, or rebuilt, and one count shows progress at each check-in.
options.how: 1. Stop new repeats: step lane-step-dup-check refuses a lane brief or new session for a step with an open lane PR, unless the brief says "continues #N" or "replaces #N". 2. One ledger, roadmap/backlog/lost-prs.json, written only by a script that reruns at each batch review (step lost-work-sweep): one row per PR with step, state, age, files and verdict (keep, duplicate, rebuild, merged). 3. Repeats first: within each step group, git cherry or patch-id marks a PR whose change is already on main or in a newer PR, and it closes with a pointer to the kept PR. 4. Quick glance: one fresh Sonnet reviewer per remaining group (at most 53) and per older single PR picks keep, rebuild or close against today's main and rulings; under-48 h work leans keep. 5. Drain: runner 10 batches keep rows that read done, newest first; keep rows without a done record get one fresh Sonnet round 1; a lane is unarchived only when its own answer is needed. 6. Finish line: unsorted rows = 0, kept at 0 by lost-work-sweep. One lane, backlog-drain, under the coordinator; runner 10 only batches.
options.label: Run plan backlog-drain (recommended)
options.lose: One lane's work and up to about 60 Sonnet review reads.

options.how: Reopen item 690 and pick among split by age, rescue all, or reset all.
options.label: Keep item 690's three options
options.lose: No duplicate check, so repeats may land twice or conflict.
